source_evidence.text:
Given a question q, ToG-2 first identifies the entities present in q and links them to entities in the
KG. This step can be done by different entity linking (EL) methods, such as LLMs or specialized EL
tools 1. Then, ToG-2 performs a Topic Prune (TP) step to select suitable entities as starting points
of exploring in a KG, which prompts the LLM to evaluate q and appearing entities, selecting topic
entities E0
topic = {e1, e2, . . . , eN} and N is determined by LLM.
Prior to the 1st-round graph retrieval, ToG-2 uses dense retrieval models (DRMs, including dual-
tower and single-tower models) to extract the top-k chunks from the documents associated with
the initial topic entities E0
topic. The LLM then evaluates whether this information is sufficient to
answer the question, drawing on its own knowledge. If it concludes that the available information is
adequate, no further steps will be required.
3.2
HYBRID KNOWLEDGE EXPLORATION
The following will illustrate how ToG-2 iteratively harmonizes and tightly couples heterogeneous
knowledge. The iterative process will be explained in two main parts, Context-enhanced Graph
Search and Knowledge-guided Context Retrieval.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.primary: 24道cross题最终必要来源覆盖率的逐题宏平均；Graph-only minus Hybrid配对差。
scoring_rules.unit: 每项参考来源要求一个单元；同单元已核查等价块OR，必要来源单元AND；不是逐字事实正确率。
scoring_rules.denominator: 32道正例；24道cross单列；8道negative只展示纠错来源诊断，不计主召回与拒答准确率。

bootstrap.scope: fixed 24-question diagnostic set; not a population guarantee; subgroups descriptive

scoring_rules.failure_attribution: post-hoc frozen support-pool IDs; no support IDs enter candidate production
scoring_rules.source_pool_limit: 完整包含原文的同论文等价块已审计；其他语义等价段落可能未列入。另报论文覆盖但不当作事实覆盖。
scoring_rules.negative_policy: source diagnostics only; exclude from aggregate recall; no refusal correctness
scoring_rules.reporting: aggregate, categories, graph-source-link strata, named/discovery, paired deltas and CI, charts, latency, usage, all 40 details and traces

evaluation_config.planned_output: 仅检索对照；无模型答案、无答案准确率

controls.reranker: same GPU FP16 model; threshold 0.05; max_pair_tokens 1024
controls.candidate_note: same total cap, not forced equal returned counts; Hybrid has two channels of 20
controls.order: alternate two arms by case index
